label: Bacterial & Protozoal Infections
description: Infectious diseases caused by bacteria and protozoa (e.g., cholera, tuberculosis).

label: Viral & Other Infectious Diseases
description: Includes viral infections (e.g., HIV, measles) and other specified infectious agents.

label: Cancer & Malignant Tumors
description: Malignant neoplasms (cancers) affecting various organs and tissues.

label: Blood & Immune Disorders
description: Disorders of blood, blood-forming organs, and the immune system (non-cancerous).

label: Endocrine & Metabolic Disorders
description: Diseases related to hormones, glands, diabetes, thyroid, and nutrition.

label: Mental & Behavioral Disorders
description: Includes depression, anxiety, schizophrenia, substance abuse, etc.

label: Nervous System Disorders
description: Diseases of the brain, spinal cord, and nerves (e.g., epilepsy, multiple sclerosis).

label: Eye, Ear & Related Disorders
description: Conditions affecting vision, hearing, and related structures.

label: Heart & Circulatory Diseases
description: Disorders of the heart and blood vessels (e.g., hypertension, stroke).

label: Lung & Breathing Conditions
description: Respiratory diseases like asthma, pneumonia, and COPD.

label: Digestive System Disorders
description: Includes diseases of the stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas, etc.

label: Skin & Subcutaneous Conditions
description: Skin diseases such as eczema, psoriasis, infections, and wounds.

label: Muscle, Bone & Joint Disorders
description: Musculoskeletal issues like arthritis, back pain, and fractures.

label: Urinary & Reproductive Conditions
description: Includes kidney disease, urinary infections, and reproductive system disorders.

label: Pregnancy & Childbirth
description: Conditions related to pregnancy, delivery, and postpartum complications.

label: Newborn & Perinatal Conditions
description: Disorders arising around birth (e.g., low birth weight, neonatal infections).

label: Congenital & Birth Defects
description: Structural or genetic conditions present from birth.

label: Symptoms & Abnormal Findings
description: General symptoms not linked to a specific diagnosis (e.g., fever, fatigue).

label: Injuries to Head & Torso
description: Trauma affecting head, neck, chest, abdomen, and pelvis.

label: Injuries to Limbs & Other Effects
description: Trauma to arms, legs, burns, poisoning, and certain complications.

label: Transport Accidents
description: Injuries from vehicles, bikes, pedestrians, etc.

label: Falls & Other External Injuries
description: Includes falls, animal bites, drowning, and suffocation.

label: Exposure & Intentional Harm
description: Exposure to fire, chemicals, self-harm, and unknown causes.

label: Assaults & Medical Complications
description: Injuries from assault, legal intervention, and treatment side effects.

label: Health Services & Status Factors
description: Encounters for checkups, vaccinations, personal or family history.

label: Special Codes & Public Health
description: Reserved codes for emerging diseases (e.g., COVID-19: U07.1).
